description: Preferred runway modes, owner-supplied 24-10-2026, in strict priority order (order in this file is the tie-break): 1 29AD36A-LAHSO; 2 29AD36A; 3 29AD18A; 4 11AD36A; 5 11AD18A. 29AD36A-LAHSO is the land-and-hold-short mode (owner, 24-10-2026): it uses the same runways as 29AD36A and ranks above it, but is allowed only with a cloud ceiling of A030 (3,000 ft) or higher, visibility of 8 km or greater and a dry surface; the other four modes have no minima. Each uses both runways: 29AD36A lands on 29 and 36 and departs from 29; 29AD18A lands on 29 and 18 and departs from 29; 11AD36A lands on 11 and 36 and departs from 11; 11AD18A lands on 11 and 18 and departs from 11. No crosswind limit or capacity has been supplied for any mode; they fall back to the pack default and have no capacity limit.

modes.description: Arrivals 29 and 36, departures 29, with land and hold short (needs ceiling A030 or higher, visibility 8 km or more, dry runway)
